att_adm_should_retrain.ai_message: Retraining will not fix this one. The Root Cause Analysis warning is latency — the agent is slow, not wrong, and its accuracy is 92.1%. A retrain improves what the model concludes, not how fast it concludes it, so the honest answer is that the two decisions are separate. Retrain early because 1,847 corrections are sitting there and tax-rule detection would gain 5.2%; do it for that reason, not to clear this warning. The latency needs a runtime look.

att_adm_harden_sync.ai_message: Weighting the next retrain toward sync detection targets the 45% of root causes that are System Sync Issues — 91 of 202 — and it is the category the operators' largest pattern traces back to. Two things worth saying: the weighting comes at the expense of the other categories in the same pass, and the sync failures themselves happen upstream in CGCM, so better detection finds them faster without stopping them. Detection tuning is the right lever here; a maintenance-window fix is the actual repair.

att_adm_current_state.user_query: How does platform tuning work today, without the console?
att_adm_current_state.ai_message: Operators report slow cycles or bad corrections, anecdotally. You hunt through per-agent logs with no single view, then guess which threshold or which agent is at fault. You push a change and wait a cycle to see whether operator accuracy moved — and when it does move, you cannot say which change moved it, so you guess again. It is a loop with lagging feedback and no attribution, which means the tuning is intuition wearing the clothes of evidence.

att_adm_future_state.user_query: Where does the console change the picture?
att_adm_future_state.ai_message: Four interventions. Hunting per-agent logs becomes one health console with accuracy, latency, error and status side by side. Guessing the fault becomes a root-cause distribution and a P95/P99 tail that explain the warning. Changing blindly and waiting a cycle becomes a retraining panel that projects the lift before you commit. And the lagging feedback loop becomes operator corrections captured automatically as labeled training data — 1,847 this month. The judgment stays yours; what changes is that it is made against evidence rather than against the last complaint you heard.
